name: Drupal Metrics
description: provides database metrics in the Reports section.
project_description:
This Drupal module provides a comprehensive overview of website structure, catering to both business stakeholders and developers. Its primary goal is to present clear insights into the size of individual database tables, distribution of pages across the site, based on content types and available language versions.

 

 

 Key Features: 

 
 Database Size Analysis
 
 Displays the size of individual database tables and the total database footprint. 
 Helps identify large tables that may affect performance and require optimization. 
 
 
 Content Type Analysis
 
 Displays the total number of pages grouped under each content type. 
 Offers detailed statistics to help identify how content is structured. 
 
 
 Multilingual Support Overview
 
 TODO: Shows the availability of language versions for pages. 
 TODO: Highlights gaps in multilingual content, aiding in localization efforts. 
 
 
 User-Friendly Interface
 
 Presents the data in an intuitive, easily accessible format for both technical and non-technical users. 
 
 
 
 Benefits: 

 
 For Business Stakeholders
 
 Enables better understanding of content distribution. 
 Assists in identifying opportunities to expand content in specific areas or languages. 
 
 
 For Developers
 
 Streamlines the audit of content management systems. 
 Provides a clear framework for maintaining multilingual content consistency. 
 
 
 
 This module is ideal for organizations managing large, complex websites with diverse content and multilingual requirements. It bridges the gap between business needs and technical insights, ensuring a streamlined content architecture/management strategy.
